Harbour Lights Guide

Every harbour light has its own character: a pattern of flashes that tells sailors exactly which light they are looking at.

Reading a light

  • Count the flashes in each group.
  • Time the pause between groups.
  1. Check the colour against the chart.

A light you cannot name is a light you cannot trust.

Fl(2) W 10s   two white flashes every ten seconds
